trainer.loaded_is: the same ADR-465/466 trainer as rounds 5-7 (training/cadex_train.py unchanged); every checkpoint and the final policy record it

registered.reason: r6 (best) failed all 10 seeds on W10 foot_lowest -0.09 to -0.175 HH (min -0.05), W8-low duty_min 0.23-0.27 (min 0.40), W9 step_count_ratio 6.3-39 (max 1.5), W7 slip 0.28-0.32 (max 0.15). Standing sink was already ~4.5 mm against the 4.8 mm limit. Sink scales with load over the foot's effective mass, and the old stance put the foot 27.5 mm forward of the knee on a ~9 g lever. MECHANISM change: stance hip 18 deg / knee -30 deg puts the foot 11 mm from the knee and 3 mm from the hip, about 5x the effective mass (HIP_MM 96.70 -> 106.95, weight unchanged). TASK change: swing pay uses foot speed relative to the body, plus a diagonal-trot term that pays one diagonal pair lifted while the other stands (a single raised foot earns nothing); yaw and heading merged. Fresh start because the mechanism changed and r7's warm start collapsed; standing still nets about +2.2/step. Expected: W10 within limit, and all feet cycling in a trot.

ended.reason: the trainer ran every iteration and its policy hashes to its receipt.

mechanism.change: script_history 0044 (abebe838, r6) -> 0049 (602c9b45, trained): params hip_pose 30 -> 18 deg and knee_pose -60 -> -30 deg (their min bounds widened to 15 and -70..-25); the four solved-pose foot-floor contacts became zero-gap clearances; HIP_MM 96.7006 -> 106.9488; reward: swing pay on body-relative foot speed, a diagonal 'trot' term, yaw and heading merged
mechanism.model_diff: 78 MJCF lines differ, all body/geom/joint positions and orientations (the base sits 10.25 mm higher); option and compiler lines, the floor plane geom, every joint range and damping, every mass and inertia, and all eight actuators (forcerange, gains) are byte-identical
mechanism.spec_lift_note: HX (p.hip_x) is unchanged, so SPEC_LIFT's value is unchanged; the stance moves each foot to about 3 mm from its hip in x, inboard of the HX + 20 lever the formula assumes, so the drawn lift is larger than the lift that just clears a 3 deg tilt -- conservative, not a contract change

evaluation.policy_is: runs/r8-stance/train/walk_task.cxpolicy (the final policy, iteration 800), installed by the agent as walk_r8.cxpolicy
evaluation.revision_change_from_trained: script_history 0049 -> 0052: policy weights walk_r6 -> walk_r8 and their sha256; nothing else

spec_block.why: the rule asks HIP_MM to equal rig.hip_height_mm to the block's printed precision (four decimals); the rig reads the hip anchors from the MJCF, written to six significant figures (0.106949 m), so it is 106.9490 and the script's 106.9488 differs by 0.0002 mm. The line also carries a trailing comment
spec_block.effect_bound: HIP_MM enters only the command range (0.6-1.0 x HIP_MM mm/s); 0.0002 mm moves the drawn command by at most 0.0002 mm/s (2e-6 relative). W6 and W10 divide by the rig's own hip height, not HIP_MM
